standard: GDD rework v2 · 80+ researched scenarios · scorecard-passed
gating: Gated (school-comfort toggle gates the pornography-literacy module)
note: Pornography & critical thinking online (UNESCO 7, 5.4, 4.3, 5.1, 5.6, 2.1, 2.3, 1.1). New v2 build, Chapter 5, the media-literacy FINALE and summit of the journey. The feed is engineered to use you, but you can learn to read it and use it instead. Decode the machine (algorithms, the attention economy, filter bubbles), decode the influence (misinformation, AI fakes/deepfakes, propaganda, scams, dark patterns), decode pornography (gated, non-explicit, deeper than g28: it's staged performance, not real, not sex-ed, unrealistic, no shame, critical thinking, contrast with healthy info), decode yourself (digital wellbeing, balance not abstinence), then synthesise into one 'decode anything' habit, and Grow (Unlearn-Relearn-Grow, a digital-life charter, carried for life). Critical, not cynical; agency over paranoia. A game about manipulation that uses no dark patterns. Builds on g28 (Reality Check) and g12/g17; closes the 3-18 journey before the c5 capstone. India: viral forwards, deepfakes, scams, DPDP Act, cybercrime 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in. Non-explicit throughout; routes distress to help.

evidenceBase: The deepest media-literacy idea is that the feed itself is designed: recommendation algorithms and the attention economy are built to maximise engagement, so what you see is selected to keep you scrolling, creating filter bubbles and echo chambers that quietly shape your view of the world. Understanding the system, not just individual fakes within it, is the leap from media-literate to digitally wise; and everyone is targeted by manipulation (misinformation, AI fakes, propaganda, scams, dark patterns), which only works while it stays invisible, so a decoder who knows the techniques can see them coming (UNESCO media & information literacy; KC7)

Pornography literacy for older teens (gated and strictly non-explicit) builds critical thinking and reduces shame: pornography is staged performance by actors, not real sex, not a relationship model and not sex education; it shows unrealistic bodies, acts and standards, often little or no real consent, communication or care, and can normalise gender-based violence, and teens' still-maturing minds are more vulnerable to its portrayals of sexual norms. The approach is to think critically and contrast it with healthy, accurate information about sex, relationships and bodies, never to shame anyone for curiosity or for having seen it (porn-literacy curricula 2025; UNESCO KC7)

Decoding yourself matters as much as decoding the world: living online on purpose means protecting attention from infinite scroll, resisting comparison, managing time and notifications, guarding privacy and your lasting digital footprint, and tending mental health, framed as balance, not abstinence, because the digital world holds real connection, learning and joy. The master habit is to decode anything (who made it and why, how the algorithm served it, what manipulation is in play, what's actually true, how I'll act), and the journey's lesson is that learning never stops, Unlearn, Relearn, Grow (UNESCO; India DPDP Act; cybercrime.gov.in / 1930)

options.consequence: Carry the Decoder and charter forward; keep learning, for life.

scenarios.debrief: What you carry forward, the Decoder, the charter, the habit, is the whole point.
scenarios.relearn: Carry the Decoder and your charter into adult life, and keep learning.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: whatever the information world throws at you, you can read it. Feel ready?
scenarios.affirm: You can read the machine, the message and yourself, you're genuinely ready.
scenarios.relearn: You're ready to read whatever the information world throws at you.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: a generation that can decode the world clearly and stay kind, worth being part of?
scenarios.affirm: A clear-eyed, kind, critical generation, that's exactly what this whole journey was for.
scenarios.relearn: Decoding clearly and staying kind is what this whole journey was for.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: one last time, together. Unlearn. Relearn. And...?
scenarios.affirm: Unlearn. Relearn. Grow. Now it's yours, for the rest of your life.
scenarios.relearn: Unlearn. Relearn. Grow, for the rest of your life.
